title: Swiss Storm Sorceress
description: A blonde woman in a black suit and white shirt floats dynamically in the center of a chaotic night storm, holding a large red umbrella emblazoned with white Swiss crosses. She is surrounded by swirling blue energy, pink petals, vintage lanterns, a vintage microphone, sailing ships battling rough seas below, and dramatic red lightning in a dark sky.
prompt: A dynamic surreal scene of a blonde woman with braided hair wearing a black suit and white shirt, floating mid-air while holding a large red umbrella covered in white Swiss crosses. She is caught in a swirling vortex of blue energy and pink petals, with a vintage microphone and glowing lanterns floating nearby. Below her, old wooden sailing ships are tossed in a stormy sea with crashing waves. The dark night sky is filled with dramatic red lightning and clouds, creating a chaotic and powerful atmosphere.
